_note: Sampling values copied from XTTS-v2's own config.json (coqui/XTTS-v2 on Hugging Face), which is what the high-level TTS API uses. Every model we compare uses this file.
_python_defaults_differ: Xtts.inference() and get_conditioning_latents() have different Python defaults in coqui-tts 0.27.5: repetition_penalty 10.0 (config: 5.0) and gpt_cond_len 6 (config: 30). We use the config values.
